# Captured 2026-10-01 from Matrix's SPA in a real Chrome: /search opened on
# flight-cli's deep link for JFK-LHR one-way, 2026-10-21, and the form showed
# the date as "Arrival", "This day only". After Search, the SPA's own URL
# state, decoded from the page URL's search= parameter (the capture kept the
# decoded JSON, not the URL text). The SPA omits a one-way's returnDate, which
# flight-cli writes as "". Its /v1/search body is
# specific_jfk_lhr_ow_arrive.json.
